value.text:
Yes, the HelioSync I10 can charge the Orion E4 through the GridNest W11, as the HelioSync gateway supports the GridNest W11 through Modbus TCP profile HS-EV-2. 

The charging power is limited by several factors: 
1. The maximum AC input of the Orion E4 is 11 kW using three-phase 400 V, 16 A per phase.
2. The GridNest W11 can request up to its configured maximum of 11 kW while the grid supplies any shortfall after available PV contribution.
3. In surplus-only mode, the controller may reduce or pause charging to maintain net import near the configured threshold.
4. The actual charging power and speed can also be limited by the lowest active limit among the vehicle, wallbox, cable, site circuit, or load-management setting.
